name: project-guardian
description: A lightweight project memory guardian for AI-assisted coding handover, onboarding, and self-service knowledge lookup.

interface.shortDescription: Keep durable project memory for AI-assisted coding teams.
interface.longDescription: Project Guardian creates and maintains standard project memory files, AI behavior rules, handover guides, pre-commit checks, project audits, and a local multi-turn knowledge query loop so new developers and AI agents can understand why the project works the way it does.
